description: Requires a Pro plan. Reveals the business email and phone of one public speaker (person_id or slug from search_speakers / get_speaker), with provenance (source, as_of). Uses 1 reveal credit when an email or phone is returned; re-viewing a contact your workspace already revealed is free, and refusals (opted out, restricted, unavailable, nothing on file) cost nothing. Needs the 'atlas.reveal' permission and the workspace's one-time acceptance of the Messe Atlas data terms; reveals are capped per day by plan. Use contacts for business-to-business outreach only.
